description: <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p>BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.</p> <p>We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.</p> <p><strong>Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.</strong></p> <p>Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.</p> <p>By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.</p> <p>We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.</p> <p>We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:</p> <ul> <li>CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)</li> <li>FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)</li> <li>Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)</li> <li>LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About this role in the team:</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Product Manager to own the product vision, strategy, and delivery for the Reporting &amp; Customer Reconciliation subdomain within BVNK's Ledger domain. You'll&nbsp; work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and commercial teams to define how BVNK's customers&nbsp; and BVNK's own internal teams — see, understand, and trust their financial data.</p> <p>The Ledger domain is the financial backbone of BVNK, a single, trusted source of truth for all customer and transactional balances across products, currencies, and rails. Within this domain, the Reporting &amp; Customer Reconciliation subdomain is responsible for providing clear, consistent financial views derived from the ledger for both internal and external reporting. Through the Reporting Service, Search Service, and downstream data surfaces,it ensures that positions, balances, and movements are accurately represented for Finance, Risk, Operations, and customers.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, cross-functional role. As part of BVNK's Billing 2.0 vision and the drive toward a 100% self-serve customer experience, you'll define and deliver the product capabilities that give customers full transparency; enabling them to reconcile invoices, audit charges programmatically, and automate close processes, while also building the internal reporting foundations that Finance, Reconciliation, and Operations depend on to scale.</p> <h4><strong>Key Areas of Responsibilities:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own the product vision and roadmap for Reporting &amp; Customer Reconciliation</strong> — Define the strategy for how BVNK exposes financial data to customers and internal teams, aligning with the broader Ledger domain mission and company objectives (Billing 2.0, self-serve experience, MiCA compliance).</li> <li><strong>Drive transaction report fee breakdowns</strong> — Define requirements and work with engineering to ensure transaction reports and APIs properly include both real-time and invoiced fees, broken down by fee type</li> <li><strong>Build the customer reconciliation product </strong>— Define and deliver customer-facing reconciliation endpoints and reporting surfaces that enable enterprise clients to programmatically audit charges, automate close processes, and reconcile against invoices.</li> <li><strong>Improve internal financial reporting</strong> — Partner with Finance, Reconciliation, and Operations to understand their data needs and deliver standardised reports and views that replace fragmented, manual processes with reliable, automated data pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across domains </strong>— Work with the Billing &amp; Fees, Wallets, Balances , Digital Assets, Treasury, and Reconciliation domain to ensure reporting data is consistent and accurate end-to-end.</li> <li><strong>Define reporting for multi-entity and regulatory requirements</strong> — As BVNK expands across jurisdictions and customer types, ensure reporting structures correctly represent entity-specific data, segregation requirements, and regulatory obligations (MiCA safekeeping, EMI reconciliation).</li> <li><strong>Own stakeholder relationships </strong>— Serve as the primary product contact for Reporting &amp; Customer Reconciliation. Engage regularly with Commercial (AMs/CSMs), Finance, Operations, and enterprise customers to gather requirements, validate solutions, and communicate roadmap priorities.</li> <li><strong>Measure and iterate</strong> — Define and track KPIs for reporting accuracy, customer adoption of reconciliation tools, reduction in manual reconciliation effort, and internal stakeholder satisfaction. title: Junior / Senior Writer
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>JUNIOR/SENIOR WRITERS - REFORM UK</h1> <p>When did you last read something from a political party and actually finish it?</p> <p>Most of it is written by people who have never had to convince anyone of anything.</p> <p>Reform UK reaches tens of millions of people and we do it with words. Very few people in politics can write for that scale. If you can, prove it.&nbsp;</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>Write for every output the party has.</p> <p>Draft directly for the party's most senior figures.</p> <p>Work fast. You will write things that millions of people read, and that our opponents will scrutinise.</p> <h2>Who we're looking for</h2> <p>Ambitious. Hungry. Fast.&nbsp;</p> <p>You do not need a degree. You do not need to have worked in politics. You do not need to have been to the right school or know the right people.</p> <p>What you do need: Excellent writing skills and an understanding of language and copy that appeals to a mass audience.</p> <p>Sharp political instincts and a real feel for what people across Britain actually think, not what Westminster thinks they think. And a genuine belief in what we are doing. This is not a job you can do at arm's length; you must immerse yourself in Reform and our message.</p> <h2>How to apply</h2> <p>Write a 500-word letter, as our Shadow Home Secretary Zia Yusuf, setting out how the political class broke Britain and how Reform UK will fix it. Attach this where you are asked for a cover letter.</p> <p>Send that, plus your CV; examples of your writing and what it achieved.</p> <h2>The details</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Title: Junior/Senior Writer - dependent on experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Pay: competitive, dependent on experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Location: Reform UK HQ, Westminster.</p> </li> <li> <p>Interviews: ASAP</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Data & Analytics Lead
description: <p><strong>Location: </strong>Westminster, London&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Salary:</strong> Competitive&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Reporting to:</strong> Executive Editor&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Reform UK is seeking an exceptional Data &amp; Analytics Lead to build a best-in-class organisation-wide data and insight function from the party's Westminster headquarters. This is a broader opportunity than a conventional web or social analytics role: the successful candidate will help bring together disparate strands of performance, audience, membership, campaign and operational information into a coherent decision-making system.</p> <p>The Data &amp; Analytics Lead will establish the data stack, reporting definitions, access, dashboards and analytical rhythms that allow senior leaders and teams across Reform UK to see what is happening, understand why and act quickly. Digital channels will be an important part of the role, but the aim is to create a shared source of decision-ready insight across the organisation wherever useful data exists.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build the organisation-wide data and insight function</li> <li>Map the major data sources, owners, definitions, access rights, reporting rhythms and decision needs across Reform UK, identifying duplication, gaps and areas where information is currently fragmented.</li> <li>Design and implement a practical data stack that can bring together appropriate information from digital channels, website, search, email, ReformGo, membership, campaigns and other organisational systems.</li> <li>Establish clear definitions, baselines, targets and data-quality standards so senior leaders are not making decisions from conflicting numbers.</li> <li>Create a roadmap that moves the organisation from isolated reports and manual extracts towards trusted, timely and increasingly automated decision support.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Build dashboards that drive decisions</strong></p> <p>Create intuitive dashboards and scorecards for senior leadership and operational teams, focused on decisions rather than data for its own sake.</p> <p>Develop role-appropriate views so executives can see the organisation-wide picture while teams can drill into the detail they need to manage performance day to day.</p> <p>Connect output and activity to outcomes wherever attribution is reasonable, helping teams understand movement from attention to owned relationship, repeat behaviour, membership, participation or other useful actions.</p> <p>Automate recurring reporting and data preparation where practical, reducing manual effort and increasing the frequency and reliability of insight.</p> <p>Ensure dashboards show trends, targets and context rather than isolated totals that can easily mislead.</p> <p><strong>Turn raw data into insight and action</strong></p> <p>Produce concise, decision-ready analysis that explains what changed, why it matters, what is likely driving it and what the organisation should do next.</p> <p>Identify where audiences, members or supporters stop progressing through journeys and work with relevant teams to test improvements.</p> <p>Create a disciplined test-and-learn framework with hypotheses, success criteria and post-test analysis so the organisation learns systematically rather than anecdotally.</p> <p>Use segmentation and cohort analysis to uncover meaningful patterns in behaviour.</p> <p><strong>Embed data-driven decision-making across Reform UK</strong></p> <p>Work with the Executive Editor, Director of Operations and other senior stakeholders to establish regular performance and insight reviews that lead to impactful decisions.</p> <p>Support Website, Video, Social, Communications, Campaigns, Membership, Operations and other teams with practical analysis, helping each function understand its own performance in the wider system.</p> <p>Challenge weak assumptions and vanity metrics constructively, distinguishing signal from noise and making clear where the evidence is incomplete or attribution is uncertain.</p> <p>Train colleagues to understand the dashboards and core metrics so data literacy increases throughout the organisation rather than becoming dependent on one analyst.</p> <p><strong>Own governance, compliance and trust</strong></p> <p>Be the internal expert on data governance for the analytics function, ensuring work aligns with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act, ICO guidance and relevant organisational policies.</p> <p>Work closely with the DPO and system owners on lawful basis, consent, minimisation, retention, access, pseudonymisation, URL/log hygiene and appropriate use of personal data.</p> <p>Maintain clear data lineage, permissions and documentation so key metrics are reproducible and sensitive information is available only to those who genuinely need it.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Performance and Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build alerting and monitoring for material changes, broken journeys, unusual movements or data-quality failures where rapid intervention is valuable.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, digital teams, campaigns, membership, operations, suppliers and technical partners so the data function is seen as an enabler rather than a reporting bottleneck.</li> <li>Communicate complex analysis in clear, plain English, surface new ideas and be confident presenting findings to senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Manage external analytics, BI, data or technology suppliers where required, ensuring integrations, costs and deliverables are properly controlled.</li> <li>Maintain political awareness and discretion when working with sensitive organisational, membership or campaign data and understand that some insights will be operationally or reputationally sensitive.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>THE PERSON</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a senior data and analytics expert who has built practical insight capability before and can turn fragmented information into a trusted system that improves decisions.</p> <p><strong>Essential experience and capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>A proven track record of establishing or materially improving a data, analytics, BI or insight operation in a complex organisation.</li> <li>Strong experience integrating disparate data sources and designing a practical reporting architecture rather than relying on disconnected manual reports.</li> <li>Demonstrable ability to build dashboards that colleagues actually use, with clear metrics, trends, context, drill-downs and decision relevance.</li> <li>Excellent analytical judgement: able to distinguish signal from noise, explain uncertainty, avoid misleading attribution and turn numbers into actionable insight.</li> <li>Strong technical competence with relevant data, analytics and BI tools, including the ability to work effectively with APIs, structured data, automation and modern dashboarding platforms.</li> <li>Experience defining KPIs, baselines, targets, cohorts and measurement frameworks across multiple functions or stages of a user/member journey.</li> <li>Outstanding communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical senior stakeholders and influence decisions without hiding behind jargon.</li> <li>Expert understanding of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act, ICO guidance, consent, minimisation, retention, access controls and good data-governance practice.</li> <li>Highly organised, self-sufficient and able to manage multiple stakeholders, systems, dependencies and priorities while maintaining clear documentation and data trust.</li> <li>Proactive and pragmatic: willing to build a useful first version quickly, automate what matters and improve iteratively rather than waiting for a perfect enterprise architecture.</li> <li>Strong interest in British politics and comfort handling sensitive information within a high-profile, mission-led political organisation where discretion and judgement are essential.</li> <li>Willingness to work full-time from Reform UK's Westminster HQ and flex around major political, This is not an SDR-reliant role.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Run a disciplined sales process. </strong>Using MEDDPICC to qualify and advance opportunities. font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Career development: Workshops and frameworks to realize your full potential.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Required Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in leading complex integration and development programmes&nbsp;</li> <li>Solid Software Engineering principles and best-practices</li> <li>Knowledge of Software Engineering standards (civilian/automotive/defence)&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of multi-stage Validation &amp; Verification techniques</li> <li>Knowledge of Simulation techniques and targets: from software-regression targets to Hardware-in-Loop platforms</li> <li>Understanding of communication pathways: Ethernet and Fieldbus&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of real-time control techniques and limitations</li> <li>Appreciation of both Application (Linux), Embedded and Firmware platforms.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving ability in high-pressure, resource-constrained environments.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and capacity to work collaboratively in multi-disciplinary teams.</li> <li>MUST be eligible for UK Security Clearance and be able to travel to the South West England area when required</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline; We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications—ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. As you will be managing several projects simultaneously, you are an organized person who can keep perspective while paying attention to details.</p> <p>In addition, you have:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience with either; Braze, Adobe Experience Platform or Salesforce marketing cloud</li> <li>Experience with managing and implementing projects within CRM, or marketing automation</li> <li>A conceptual, and a technical, understanding of data modelling, service-oriented and layered architectures, and complex technical solutions in general</li> <li>Worked with agile methods of Scrum and/or Kanban</li> <li>Great communication skills, enabling you to translate “business language” into technical language.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>A leader in personalized customer experiences</h2> <p>MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. Together, we are 1000 + technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-EMEA</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (MAP/VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. title: Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan. Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale. In this role you will: Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. raw.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services
raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. These are the two metrics that define success in this role

  • Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close

  • Partner with the Enterprise Sales Lead to turn warm introductions into qualified opportunities and closed deals

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows. Our public use cases include account inquiries, payment support, fraud triage, loan origination, claims processing, collections, and compliance verification. Others include caller verification, onboarding, policy servicing and renewals, and contact center coaching

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in AI governance and model risk

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, Technology, and Risk, Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through model-risk, security, and architecture review, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Financial Services positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • At least 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Financial services experience (banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, payments) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (CX, operations, digital), and to risk and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including regulated-industry vendor risk, model risk, and data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

  • High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

title: Banking Accounting Manager
description: <h2>🧡 About Alma</h2> <p>At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place — serving merchants and consumers.</p> <p>Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience — without encouraging bad debt.</p> <p>As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.</p> <p>With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR in 2025, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!</p> <h2>👐 About the team</h2> <p>Alma is a lender. We originate several million consumer receivables a year, carry them for a few weeks, and refinance them off a deliberately light balance sheet through securitization vehicles (Fonds Communs de Titrisation) and our other funding lines. We are regulated as a société de financement and a payment institution.</p> <p>That changes what "accounting" means here. A lender's accounts are not a monthly deliverable produced at the end of a chain: <strong>they are the chain</strong>. Every payment event, every commission, every provision, every sale of receivables to an FCT has to become a journal entry that ties — to the transaction underneath it, to the general ledger above it, and to the prudential statements the regulator reads. At our scale and growth, this is a strategic topic, and one that is as much about data as it is about accounting.</p> <p>Today the chain exists: an internal core banking ledger we built ourselves, feeding NetSuite, feeding regulatory reporting. What it does not have is a single owner who understands it end-to-end, holds it to the standard a regulated lender needs, and evolves it as the business changes (geographies, products, licenses). That is the role we are opening.</p> <p>You will join an Accounting team inside a Finance organization of ~15 people covering Strategic Financing, FP&amp;A, Accounting, Regulatory reporting and Controlling. You will report to the Head of Financing &amp; Accounting, alongside the Financing team and the General Accounting Manager, who oversees corporate cycles, tax, statutory and consolidated accounts.</p> <p>This is a role with unusual ownership for its level: the banking accounting scope is yours from day one, and so is the data chain that produces it.</p> <h2>💼 About the job</h2> <p><strong>Own the accounting of the credit business:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own how the portfolio is represented in the books: origination, revenue recognition on merchant and customer commissions, deferred income, write-offs and recoveries, cost of risk and provisioning on performing and non-performing exposures.</li> <li>Own the accounting of our securitizations: sales of receivables to the FCTs, derecognition, discount and over-collateralisation, residual interests, servicing and management fees, hedging.</li> <li>Own the accounting of our funding: corporate debt, commercial paper, and the new funding instruments we add as the refinancing strategy evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the core banking ledger:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be the functional owner of the engine that turns business events into accounting: which event, which account, which currency, which date, which counterparty.</li> <li>Specify and validate the accounting schemes for every new product, partner and geography, and work with Engineering and Data on the ledger's model, its feed into the ERP, and the fixes when something drifts.</li> <li>Own the audit trail end-to-end — from a single €40 installment to a line in a prudential statement — and make it documented enough to be walked through by someone whose job is to challenge it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reinforce the control framework:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and automate the reconciliations that hold the whole thing together: ledger ↔ general ledger ↔ bank ↔ FCT reporting ↔ prudential statements.</li> <li>Shorten monthly close, incl. turning a manual, end-of-month, spreadsheet-based check into an automated, evidenced, repeatable control.</li> <li>Be Finance's counterpart to Internal Control and Periodic Control on everything accounting-data related.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own regulatory reporting:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the production and the quality of our prudential and statistical reporting — solvency, large exposures, liquidity, and the statistical returns that go with them.</li> <li>Own the reconciliation tables that matter most: prudential statements to accounting balances, regulatory returns to the trial balance, own funds and RWA back to their audit trail.</li> <li>Own the reporting tooling and its data feeds, and work with the Regulatory and Financing teams on the evolutions of the prudential framework and on the treatment of our securitizations.</li> </ul> <h2>🧩 About you</h2> <p><strong>To succeed in this job:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have around 6-7 years of experience, ideally starting in audit of financial services — banks, consumer credit, asset management, securitization — in a Big 4 or a specialised practice, possibly with a first move in-house. You know how to build a number, prove it, and defend it line by line in front of people whose job is to challenge it.</li> <li>You know banking accounting for real: French banking GAAP, the PCEC, cost of risk, revenue recognition on credit products. Or you know financial services accounting well enough that the banking layer is a matter of months, not years.</li> <li>You actually enjoy controls at scale — reconciling large populations, hunting the anomaly, chasing the last twelve euros of a four-hundred-million balance until you know exactly where they went. If that sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this is not your role.</li> <li>You are autonomous and scrappy. On things to build, or on things that already exist.</li> <li>You are fluent in English and French — our documentation and our regulator are French, part of our business and our team are not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>And it will be nice if you also:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold, or are working towards, the DEC (or CPA, ACCA, equivalent).</li> <li>Have been exposed to securitization — FCTs, SPVs, waterfalls, deconsolidation — or to a regulated credit institution from the inside.</li> <li><strong>You are autonomous on data.</strong> SQL is a daily tool, a data warehouse does not intimidate you, and your reflex in front of a five-million-row population is to query it, not to ask someone for a summary. This is the single most important line in this job description.</li> <li>Know NetSuite, BigQuery, dbt or Python.</li> <li>Have worked in a scaling fintech.</li> </ul> <p>Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</p> <h2>🤑 Compensation &amp; Benefits</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary based on 12 months</li> <li>Profit-sharing and employee savings plan</li> <li>Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package</li> <li>Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma</li> <li>Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li>Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.</li> <li>Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)</li> <li>Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma</li> <li>Mental health: free access to MindDay platform</li> <li>Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)</li> <li>Access to our Learning &amp; Development Platform</li> <li>2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer</li> </ul> <h2>🎯 Interview Process</h2> <ul> <li>Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation &amp; present you the role.</li> <li>Video call with Thibaut Mercier, Head of Financing, Regulatory Capital Optimization &amp; Accounting</li> <li>Business case</li> <li>Video call with Stephanie Combe, CFO</li> </ul> <h2>🌍 Diversity &amp; Inclusion</h2> <p>At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Fraud & AML Ops
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Role context Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations. As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead , you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk. Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection. This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house. Responsibilities Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs. Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks. Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records. Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews. Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning. Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs. Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual. First 6–12 months Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live. Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times. Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch. By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners. What we’re looking for Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions. Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed. Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case. Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance. Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes. Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate. Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity. Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders. Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving. Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage. Languages, presence and location Fluent French and English are mandatory. Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris. Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role. Why join Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up. Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling. Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth. Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project. Recruitment Process 1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter 2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager 3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h) 4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min) 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: -Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) -Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant -Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes -Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères. Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- . Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement ." Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Backend & Applied AI Engineer
description: 🏨 The Company Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care. Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources. Our solutions optimise patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in-depth analysis of real-world data. 📝 Your Role In a nutshell You will join our engineering team as a Backend & Applied AI Engineer. Your role will focus primarily on a product used to structure real-world clinical data: developing and maintaining product services and APIs, improving performance and architecture, and strengthening production reliability. You will also contribute to the delivery of AI-enabled features through code review and backend integration. In the short and medium term, the role is expected to be approximately 75% backend and 25% Applied AI. This split may evolve with team and product needs, without a predefined trajectory. Your impact Become progressively autonomous on the product backend during your first six months. Reduce production blind spots by improving incident detection and follow-through. Evolve the architecture to better support concurrency, parallelism and processing volumes. Help the team deliver AI components that are reliable, performant and properly integrated into the product. Your day-to-day work Develop and maintain backend services and APIs in Python. Work with the rest of the team, to deliver product changes end to end. Measure and improve processing time, scalability and backend architecture. Strengthen testing, CI/CD, observability and production reliability. Collaborate with, the Applied AI Engineer, particularly on pull-request reviews and the backend integration of AI-enabled features. ✨ Your Team You will work closely with: Ivan Panico — Lead ML Engineer and your manager , who will support your ramp-up and major architectural decisions. title: Technical Implementation Manager / Chef.fe de Projet Déploiement Technique
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. 🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins. L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Elle accompagne chaque hôpital dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration. Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations. Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un profil à la croisée de la technique et de la gestion de projet : une personne capable de piloter un déploiement client de bout en bout, mais aussi de prendre en main les aspects techniques de l'intégration de nos solutions. Si tu aimes autant comprendre comment fonctionnent les systèmes informatiques que coordonner les parties prenantes d'un projet, ce poste devrait te plaire ! 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous En tant que Technical Implementation Manager, tu seras responsable de la mise en œuvre technique de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé, depuis le cadrage initial jusqu'à leur mise en production. Ton rôle ? Faire en sorte que nos solutions s'intègrent correctement dans les systèmes d'information hospitaliers, tout en garantissant le bon déroulement des déploiements. Concrètement, tu seras amené(e) à : 🔧 Piloter et réaliser les déploiements techniques Configurer et déployer nos applications dans les environnements informatiques de nos clients. Mettre en place et configurer les flux d'interopérabilité entre nos solutions et les systèmes d'information hospitaliers (notamment HL7). Travailler avec les équipes IT des établissements sur les prérequis techniques : serveurs Windows, réseau, connectivité, VPN, SFTP, certificats et sécurité. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques rencontrés lors des installations et des mises en production. 📋 Gérer tes projets d'implémentation de bout en bout Organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage technique avec les établissements de santé. Identifier les besoins, les contraintes et les prérequis techniques nécessaires au déploiement. Coordonner les différents interlocuteurs (DSI, équipes techniques hospitalières, chefs de projet, équipes internes Lifen) pour assurer la bonne avancée des projets. Suivre les différentes étapes du déploiement, anticiper les risques, lever les blocages et garantir la qualité des mises en production. 🔍 Garantir le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions Réaliser les tests techniques et fonctionnels avec les clients afin de valider le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions de bout en bout. Analyser les incidents et identifier leur origine (configuration, connectivité, flux, application...). Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 en collaboration avec les équipes Support, Produit et R&D. Surveiller les flux et les certificats pour anticiper les dysfonctionnements. 🤝 Être un interlocuteur technique de confiance pour nos clients Échanger directement avec les équipes IT des hôpitaux pour résoudre les problématiques d'intégration. Savoir expliquer des sujets techniques à des interlocuteurs moins techniques. Comprendre les contraintes du terrain pour proposer des solutions adaptées, fiables et pérennes. 🚀 Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos déploiements Documenter les configurations, les procédures et les problématiques rencontrées. Identifier des opportunités pour standardiser, automatiser et fiabiliser nos déploiements. Faire remonter les retours terrain aux équipes Produit et R&D pour contribuer à l'évolution de nos solutions. Développer progressivement une expertise sur l'ensemble de nos produits. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Nous recherchons avant tout un profil technique qui aime gérer des projets, résoudre des problèmes concrets et travailler directement avec les clients. 🖥️ De solides bases techniques Tu as une expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l'intégration ou l'administration de solutions logicielles et tu es à l'aise avec plusieurs des environnements et technologies suivants : Systèmes : environnements Windows Server, administration système, GPO, installation et configuration d'applications. Réseaux et connectivité : TCP/IP, VPN, SFTP, certificats et notions de sécurité informatique. Intégration applicative : compréhension des échanges de données entre applications, des flux et des problématiques d'interopérabilité. Diagnostic technique : capacité à analyser des logs, identifier l'origine d'un incident et conduire sa résolution. Tu n'as pas besoin d'être expert(e) sur chacune de ces technologies, mais tu dois avoir suffisamment de bagage technique pour être autonome face aux problématiques d'un déploiement. 📋 Une expérience en gestion de projet technique Tu as déjà coordonné des déploiements ou des projets d'intégration de logiciels chez des clients, en collaboration avec plusieurs interlocuteurs techniques et métiers. Tu sais organiser un projet, suivre ses étapes, anticiper les risques et faire avancer les sujets jusqu'à leur résolution. 🤝 Une vraie aisance dans la relation client Tu es capable d'échanger aussi bien avec un administrateur système ou un responsable IT qu'avec un chef de projet ou un utilisateur métier. Tu sais vulgariser les sujets techniques, poser les bonnes questions et construire une relation de confiance avec tes interlocuteurs. 🛠️ Un état d'esprit orienté résolution de problèmes Tu aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent, investiguer lorsqu'un problème survient et trouver des solutions concrètes. Tu es autonome, rigoureux(se), proactif(ve) et tu n'hésites pas à mettre les mains dans le cambouis plutôt que de simplement coordonner les actions des autres. 🏥 Une connaissance du secteur de la santé est un plus Une expérience dans un établissement de santé, chez un éditeur de logiciels de santé ou dans l'intégration de systèmes d'information hospitaliers sera particulièrement appréciée. Une connaissance des standards d'interopérabilité en santé, notamment HL7, est également un vrai atout. Mais ce n'est pas indispensable : si tu disposes d'un solide socle technique et d'une expérience en déploiement logiciel, nous pourrons t'accompagner dans la découverte des spécificités du secteur hospitalier. 💎 Nos avantages Package entre 40-47K€ Mode de travail : Commuter (3 jours/semaine au bureau) Une carte Swile avec 9 €/jour (50 % Lifen) Une mutuelle santé incluant médecine alternative et soutien en santé mentale (55 % Lifen) 30 €/mois pour concerts, musées ou même pour rembourser ton abonnement Spotify Une prise en charge à 100 % du congé maternité et paternité + 5 jours enfants malades par an 1 offsite avec ton équipe par semestre + 1 offsite global Lifen par an + 1 monthly où nous nous retrouvons tous au bureau à Paris Et enfin : une politique de rémunération transparente et graduelle 👥 Notre process de recrutement Premier échange RH avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager (30 minutes) Entretien manager avec Loïc (45 minutes) Cas pratique technique à préparer chez soi, puis restitution et discussion avec l'équipe dans nos locaux (1 heure) Entretien final avec deux Lifeners d'une autre équipe Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique. title: First RevOps
description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records. The next six months are going to move fast. We'll double to +60 people, open Germany, and triple the size of our Revenue team. Today, too much of how we run the company still depends on manual work and tools that don't talk to each other. Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours. Your mission Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work. Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. On top of that, you'll work on Sales, Marketing and Finance Ops topics, like billing, cash tracking and commissions. You'll report to Clem, our Ops Lead, and work every day with the founders and the go-to-market teams. You build things, you don't write decks about them. raw.title: First RevOps
raw.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records.

The next six months are going to move fast. We'll double to +60 people, open Germany, and triple the size of our Revenue team. Today, too much of how we run the company still depends on manual work and tools that don't talk to each other.

Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours.

Your mission

Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work.

Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. On top of that, you'll work on Sales, Marketing and Finance Ops topics, like billing, cash tracking and commissions.

You'll report to Clem, our Ops Lead, and work every day with the founders and the go-to-market teams. You build things, you don't write decks about them. There's no team to manage at first, but the function is yours to shape, and we assume it will grow.

What you'll do

Own Attio, end to end

  • Administer and configure Attio: data model, pipelines, fields, views, access rights and workflows

  • Enrich our CRM with data valuable for Sales, Ops and Finance teams, so that it can be the source of truth while scaling

  • Connect Attio to the rest of our stack so processes run without manual steps

  • Support users and turn their pain points into better configurations

Automate our internal work, with AI where it makes sense

  • Map repetitive tasks across Sales, Marketing, Ops and Finance, and prioritize them by impact and effort

  • Build automations, integrations and AI use cases yourself, with no-code or low-code tools, and APIs when needed

  • Pick a simple rule or AI depending on the need, test on real cases, and keep a human in the loop when it matters

  • Protect sensitive data, control access, and measure time saved, errors and costs

Make Sales and Ops steering reliable

  • Help define the priority metrics and agree on shared definitions

  • Run the analyses, SQL queries and dashboards yourself

  • Automate data collection and updates to kill manual reporting

Build processes that hold as we double

  • Document the rules, owners, limits of AI use and what to do when something breaks

  • Structure the handoffs between teams, train users and check real adoption in the field

Outcomes

You ship from week one: automations are expected in your first month, not in six.

Month 1: diagnose and ship a first win

  • You run Attio autonomously, have audited its configuration and data, and shipped the first improvements teams feel

  • A prioritized list of automation and AI opportunities, and a 90-day plan validated with Clem

  • Your first automation is live, tested with its users, with a baseline measured to track the gain

Month 2: deploy and measure

  • Several automations are used by the teams, with time saved and output quality tracked on real cases

  • Priority metrics are live and tested with the teams

Month 3: stabilize and drive adoption

  • Several automations run in production, used regularly, with error monitoring and a clear maintenance owner

  • Attio and our data are reliable enough for the priority processes, and shared metrics are used to make decisions

  • Users are trained, and your 6-month extension plan is validated with Clem

Month 6: scale what works

  • The solutions that work are extended, documented and monitored

  • The key handoffs between teams are structured and adopted, keeping pace as we grow to around 60 people and open Germany

You are

The non-negotiable

  • You have run a CRM yourself, not just used it. You have administered, configured and optimized one personally: data model, pipelines, permissions, workflows, integrations. Attio experience is a plus; if you come from another CRM, you can show you will master Attio fast. Strong automation or AI skills won't make up for this one

Also essential

  • 3-5 years of RevOps, SalesOps or BizOps experience in a B2B startup, with business automations you built and shipped yourself

  • Real use of AI applied to internal work, and the judgment to know when a simple rule does the job better

  • At ease with data: you write SQL, run your own analyses and build dashboards; you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

  • Autonomous and pragmatic: you don't wait for a detailed spec, you go after the high-impact problems and deliver simple, usable solutions

  • Rigorous: you check your work, set up controls and document so processes are reproducible

  • You explain technical topics simply to business teams, and get them to agree on rules and actually adopt them

Nice to have

  • A solid understanding of how a SaaS business works, from sales cycle to operations to billing

And you share our values

  • Play to Win: you set ambitious, measurable goals and own the result

  • High Trust, High Standards: you keep your commitments, raise risks early and hold a high quality bar

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: you take feedback, change course when facts say so, and do the unglamorous work yourself

  • Win as One Team: you put the collective goal ahead of your own scope

  • Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: you own your mistakes and keep perspective when things get tense

Hiring process

  1. First call with Wallerand: our values, your background, and a first look at your CRM and automation experience

  2. Interview with Clem, Ops Lead: your future manager, deep dive into how you build and run a CRM and your automations

  3. Case study at our Paris office with Paul (CEO) and Clem: you structure and configure a CRM, then automate a process, from framing to a working prototype

  4. Founder interview with Paul

  5. Reference checks, with your consent

  6. Offer

Why should you join us?

  • AI with real-world impact. Our agents free hospital teams from paperwork, in a system where 70% of French hospitals are in deficit

  • A function to build from scratch. You are our first RevOps: the stack, the processes and how we use AI internally are yours to design

  • The right moment. A $20M Series A closed in March 2026, the team doubling to around 60 people, Germany opening, and everything still to build

  • An AI-native company that practices what it sells. We automate hospitals; you get to automate Parallel

  • Top-tier backers and founders. Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, the CEO of Mistral AI; founders from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo

  • Direct line to the founders. You work daily with Paul and the founding team, and your work shapes how the company scales

  • Room to grow. The role starts hands-on, with the prospect of building a team as the function grows

  • Competitive package. A competitive salary and equity (BSPCE), so you share in what you help build

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.   Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels). • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées. • Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.   Gestion des fournisseurs • Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques. • Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations. • Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires. • Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.   Qualité et amélioration continue • Participer aux audits internes et externes. • Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail. • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance. • Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité. • Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue. • Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).   ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : • proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ; • valider les choix techniques des installations ; • décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ; • arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ; • sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation. • Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.   RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES En interne • Direction des Opérations • Responsable Parc Automobile • Responsable Exploitation • Service Qualité • Conducteurs • Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température). En externe • Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques • Prestataires de métrologie • Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.   PROFIL RECHERCHE Formation • Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent. Expérience • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire. • Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne. Compétences techniques • Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision. • Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid. • Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15- 140 / COFRAC). • Analyse de données de température. • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique. Qualités personnelles • Sens de l'organisation. • Rigueur et méthode. • Esprit d'analyse. • Capacité de prise de décision. • Aisance relationnelle. • Force de proposition. • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs. • Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence. Objectifs du poste • Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules. • Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique. • Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température. • Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport. • Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
